label: bug
file: src/export/csv.ts

The issue described matches the suspicion that the CSV writer is merging rows with identical date, amount, and description regardless of currency. The bug seems to lie in the CSV export logic that must consider currency as part of the row distinction. Since the report uses writeCsv from src/export/csv.ts, that file is the appropriate place to fix the merging logic to handle different currencies correctly.
